# FF_Stocks Indicators — CUP_AND_HANDLE_SCREENER

Source: https://www.tradingview.com/script/4a4gp6cL-FF-Stocks-Indicators-CUP-AND-HANDLE-SCREENER/

## Description

Aug 6, 2026 - Includes chart patterns for detected tickers

---

## Source Code

````pine
//@version=6
// ============================================================
// Indicators_Plot_CUP_AND_HANDLE_SCREENER  —  auto-generated by FF_Finance
// Watchlist : CUP_AND_HANDLE_SCREENER
// Generated : 2026-08-06 21:16:49
// Patterns  : 2 cup and handle, 0 trendlines, 0 tunnels, 0 rise curves  (2 total)
// ============================================================

indicator("FF_Stocks Indicators — CUP_AND_HANDLE_SCREENER", overlay=true, max_lines_count=500, max_labels_count=500)

// ─── Cup & Handle Inputs ────────────────────────────────────────
cup_color    = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Cup Color")
handle_color = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Handle Color")
pivot_color  = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Pivot Color")
target_color = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Target Color")
line_width   = input.int(3, "Line Width", minval=1, maxval=5)
show_labels  = input.bool(true, "Show Labels")
show_target  = input.bool(true, "Show Target Line")
label_size   = input.string("Normal", "Range Label Size", options=["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"])
// ─── TrendLine Inputs ───────────────────────────────────────────
tl_support_color    = input.color(color.new(color.lime, 0), "TrendLine: Support Color")
tl_resistance_color = input.color(color.new(color.red, 0),  "TrendLine: Resistance Color")
tl_line_width       = input.int(1, "TrendLine: Width", minval=1, maxval=5)
tl_show_labels      = input.bool(true, "TrendLine: Show Labels")
// ─── Tunnel Inputs ──────────────────────────────────────────────
tn_color       = input.color(color.new(color.white, 0), "Tunnel: Color")
tn_line_width  = input.int(2, "Tunnel: Width", minval=1, maxval=5)
tn_show_labels = input.bool(true, "Tunnel: Show Labels")
// ─── Rise Curve Inputs ──────────────────────────────────────────
rc_color       = input.color(color.new(color.orange, 0), "Rise Curve: Color")
rc_line_width  = input.int(2, "Rise Curve: Width", minval=1, maxval=5)
rc_show_labels = input.bool(true, "Rise Curve: Show Labels")

// ─── Cup & Handle ───────────────────────────────────────────────
f_draw_ch() =>
    // ─── Cup & Handle — Pattern Data ───────────────────────────
    var ch_tickers          = array.from("SBLK", "ZGN")
    var ch_left_peak_ts     = array.from(1716940800000, 1711065600000)
    var ch_left_peak_price  = array.from(27.4700, 15.2100)
    var ch_bottom_ts        = array.from(1744156800000, 1744156800000)
    var ch_bottom_price     = array.from(12.0600, 6.0500)
    var ch_right_peak_ts    = array.from(1781481600000, 1780272000000)
    var ch_right_peak_price = array.from(27.4000, 14.6900)
    var ch_handle_start_ts  = array.from(1781481600000, 1780272000000)
    var ch_handle_end_ts    = array.from(1784851200000, 1785369600000)
    var ch_handle_low       = array.from(23.8600, 12.6300)
    var ch_pivot_price      = array.from(27.4700, 15.2100)
    var ch_target_price     = array.from(42.8800, 24.3700)
    var ch_potential_pct    = array.from(56.1000, 60.2200)
    var ch_depth_pct        = array.from(56.1000, 60.2200)
    if barstate.islast and array.size(ch_tickers) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(ch_tickers) - 1
            if array.get(ch_tickers, i) == syminfo.ticker

                // Cup arc geometry — 10 segments per half, 20 total
                int   gx0 = array.get(ch_left_peak_ts, i)
                int   gxM = array.get(ch_bottom_ts, i)
                int   gxN = array.get(ch_right_peak_ts, i)
                float gy0 = array.get(ch_left_peak_price, i)
                float gyM = array.get(ch_bottom_price, i)
                float gyN = array.get(ch_right_peak_price, i)
                int   gxL1 = gx0 + 1 * (gxM - gx0) / 10
                int   gxL2 = gx0 + 2 * (gxM - gx0) / 10
                int   gxL3 = gx0 + 3 * (gxM - gx0) / 10
                int   gxL4 = gx0 + 4 * (gxM - gx0) / 10
                int   gxL5 = gx0 + 5 * (gxM - gx0) / 10
                int   gxL6 = gx0 + 6 * (gxM - gx0) / 10
                int   gxL7 = gx0 + 7 * (gxM - gx0) / 10
                int   gxL8 = gx0 + 8 * (gxM - gx0) / 10
                int   gxL9 = gx0 + 9 * (gxM - gx0) / 10
                float gyL1 = gyM + (gy0 - gyM) * 81.0 / 100.0
                float gyL2 = gyM + (gy0 - gyM) * 64.0 / 100.0
                float gyL3 = gyM + (gy0 - gyM) * 49.0 / 100.0
                float gyL4 = gyM + (gy0 - gyM) * 36.0 / 100.0
                float gyL5 = gyM + (gy0 - gyM) * 25.0 / 100.0
                float gyL6 = gyM + (gy0 - gyM) * 16.0 / 100.0
                float gyL7 = gyM + (gy0 - gyM) * 9.0 / 100.0
                float gyL8 = gyM + (gy0 - gyM) * 4.0 / 100.0
                float gyL9 = gyM + (gy0 - gyM) * 1.0 / 100.0
                int   gxR1 = gxM + 1 * (gxN - gxM) / 10
                int   gxR2 = gxM + 2 * (gxN - gxM) / 10
                int   gxR3 = gxM + 3 * (gxN - gxM) / 10
                int   gxR4 = gxM + 4 * (gxN - gxM) / 10
                int   gxR5 = gxM + 5 * (gxN - gxM) / 10
                int   gxR6 = gxM + 6 * (gxN - gxM) / 10
                int   gxR7 = gxM + 7 * (gxN - gxM) / 10
                int   gxR8 = gxM + 8 * (gxN - gxM) / 10
                int   gxR9 = gxM + 9 * (gxN - gxM) / 10
                float gyR1 = gyM + (gyN - gyM) * 1.0 / 100.0
                float gyR2 = gyM + (gyN - gyM) * 4.0 / 100.0
                float gyR3 = gyM + (gyN - gyM) * 9.0 / 100.0
                float gyR4 = gyM + (gyN - gyM) * 16.0 / 100.0
                float gyR5 = gyM + (gyN - gyM) * 25.0 / 100.0
                float gyR6 = gyM + (gyN - gyM) * 36.0 / 100.0
                float gyR7 = gyM + (gyN - gyM) * 49.0 / 100.0
                float gyR8 = gyM + (gyN - gyM) * 64.0 / 100.0
                float gyR9 = gyM + (gyN - gyM) * 81.0 / 100.0

                // Cup arc — 10 segments per half; xloc.bar_time snaps to nearest bar
                line.new(x1=gx0, y1=gy0, x2=gxL1, y2=gyL1, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxL1, y1=gyL1, x2=gxL2, y2=gyL2, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxL2, y1=gyL2, x2=gxL3, y2=gyL3, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxL3, y1=gyL3, x2=gxL4, y2=gyL4, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxL4, y1=gyL4, x2=gxL5, y2=gyL5, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxL5, y1=gyL5, x2=gxL6, y2=gyL6, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxL6, y1=gyL6, x2=gxL7, y2=gyL7, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxL7, y1=gyL7, x2=gxL8, y2=gyL8, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxL8, y1=gyL8, x2=gxL9, y2=gyL9, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxL9, y1=gyL9, x2=gxM, y2=gyM, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxM, y1=gyM, x2=gxR1, y2=gyR1, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxR1, y1=gyR1, x2=gxR2, y2=gyR2, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxR2, y1=gyR2, x2=gxR3, y2=gyR3, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxR3, y1=gyR3, x2=gxR4, y2=gyR4, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxR4, y1=gyR4, x2=gxR5, y2=gyR5, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxR5, y1=gyR5, x2=gxR6, y2=gyR6, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxR6, y1=gyR6, x2=gxR7, y2=gyR7, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxR7, y1=gyR7, x2=gxR8, y2=gyR8, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxR8, y1=gyR8, x2=gxR9, y2=gyR9, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=gxR9, y1=gyR9, x2=gxN, y2=gyN, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=cup_color, width=line_width)

                // Handle arc geometry — 10 segments, symmetric parabola dip
                int   hx0 = array.get(ch_handle_start_ts, i)
                int   hx1 = array.get(ch_handle_end_ts, i)
                float hlw = array.get(ch_handle_low, i)
                int   hhx1 = hx0 + 1 * (hx1 - hx0) / 10
                int   hhx2 = hx0 + 2 * (hx1 - hx0) / 10
                int   hhx3 = hx0 + 3 * (hx1 - hx0) / 10
                int   hhx4 = hx0 + 4 * (hx1 - hx0) / 10
                int   hhx5 = hx0 + 5 * (hx1 - hx0) / 10
                int   hhx6 = hx0 + 6 * (hx1 - hx0) / 10
                int   hhx7 = hx0 + 7 * (hx1 - hx0) / 10
                int   hhx8 = hx0 + 8 * (hx1 - hx0) / 10
                int   hhx9 = hx0 + 9 * (hx1 - hx0) / 10
                float hhy1 = hlw + (gyN - hlw) * 16.0 / 25.0
                float hhy2 = hlw + (gyN - hlw) * 9.0 / 25.0
                float hhy3 = hlw + (gyN - hlw) * 4.0 / 25.0
                float hhy4 = hlw + (gyN - hlw) * 1.0 / 25.0
                float hhy5 = hlw + (gyN - hlw) * 0.0 / 25.0
                float hhy6 = hlw + (gyN - hlw) * 1.0 / 25.0
                float hhy7 = hlw + (gyN - hlw) * 4.0 / 25.0
                float hhy8 = hlw + (gyN - hlw) * 9.0 / 25.0
                float hhy9 = hlw + (gyN - hlw) * 16.0 / 25.0

                // Handle arc — 10 segments
                line.new(x1=hx0, y1=gyN, x2=hhx1, y2=hhy1, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=hhx1, y1=hhy1, x2=hhx2, y2=hhy2, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=hhx2, y1=hhy2, x2=hhx3, y2=hhy3, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=hhx3, y1=hhy3, x2=hhx4, y2=hhy4, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=hhx4, y1=hhy4, x2=hhx5, y2=hhy5, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=hhx5, y1=hhy5, x2=hhx6, y2=hhy6, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=hhx6, y1=hhy6, x2=hhx7, y2=hhy7, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=hhx7, y1=hhy7, x2=hhx8, y2=hhy8, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=hhx8, y1=hhy8, x2=hhx9, y2=hhy9, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)
                line.new(x1=hhx9, y1=hhy9, x2=hx1, y2=gyN, xloc=xloc.bar_time, color=handle_color, width=line_width)

                // Pivot line (dotted, spans full cup + handle width)
                float pivot = array.get(ch_pivot_price, i)
                line.new(x1=gx0, y1=pivot, x2=hx1, y2=pivot, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_dotted, color=pivot_color, width=line_width)

                // Target line (dotted, toggleable)
                float target = array.get(ch_target_price, i)
                if show_target and not na(target)
                    line.new(x1=gx0, y1=target, x2=hx1, y2=target, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_dotted, color=target_color, width=line_width)

                string sz = label_size == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : label_size == "Small" ? size.small : label_size == "Large" ? size.large : label_size == "Huge" ? size.huge : size.normal
                // Labels
                if show_labels
                    label.new(x=gxM, y=gyM, text="▼ " + str.tostring(array.get(ch_depth_pct, i), "#.##") + "%", xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(cup_color, 80), textcolor=cup_color, size=size.small)
                    label.new(x=hx1, y=pivot, text="Pivot  " + str.tostring(pivot, "#.##"), xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(pivot_color, 80), textcolor=pivot_color, size=size.small)
                    line.new(x1=gxM, y1=gyM, x2=gxM, y2=pivot, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_dashed, color=pivot_color, width=1)
                    label.new(x=gxM, y=(gyM + pivot) / 2.0, text="↑ " + str.tostring(pivot - gyM, "#.##") + " (" + str.tostring((pivot - gyM) / gyM * 100.0, "#.##") + "%)", xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(pivot_color, 15), textcolor=color.black, size=sz)
                    if show_target and not na(target)
                        label.new(x=hx1, y=target, text="Target " + str.tostring(target, "#.##") + "  (+" + str.tostring(array.get(ch_potential_pct, i), "#.##") + "%)", xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(target_color, 80), textcolor=target_color, size=size.small)
                        line.new(x1=hx1, y1=pivot, x2=hx1, y2=target, xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=line.style_dashed, color=target_color, width=1)
                        label.new(x=hx1, y=(pivot + target) / 2.0, text="↑ " + str.tostring(target - pivot, "#.##") + " (+" + str.tostring(array.get(ch_potential_pct, i), "#.##") + "%)", xloc=xloc.bar_time, style=label.style_label_left, color=color.new(target_color, 15), textcolor=color.black, size=sz)

f_draw_ch()
````
